description: Rune Alexander has lived with type 1 diabetes since the age of 9. He holds a degree in computer engineering specializing in software development and a master’s in ICT with a focus on artificial intelligence. He leads the company with a unique combination of personal experience, professional insight, and technical expertise.

With a background in computer engineering and a master’s degree in ICT specialized in artificial intelligence, Peshang leads the technical development of Varde and drives the product’s continuous innovation.

As a graduate economist specializing in business development, Rasmus provides a sharp strategic approach to the company’s growth. He drives key financial strategies and helps develop sustainable business models.
